comparability_notes: 50 and 80 epochs are separate protocols; epochs, base width, learning rate, effective batch and worker count change together.
Positive 16-structure macro Dice and 9-domain positive union Dice have different targets and denominators.
Structured checkpoints selected on validation 16-structure positive macro Dice; single-channel checkpoints on validation 9-domain positive union Dice.
Unified union evaluation uses only annotated output channels and available labels. Task-ID receives oracle annotated task IDs; it is not blind routing.
Matched images and primary loss do not imply matched parameter count, FLOPs or elapsed GPU time.
Seeds 42/43/44 vary training randomness on a fixed split; these are not cross-validation folds.
All auxiliary loss coefficients are zero in these fair suites; results do not test a Region configuration with nonzero coarse/routing auxiliary supervision.
